svg.title: For the right side, expand Buy into finitely many tickets. A ticket with leaf set D has switch dependence x|D|1D⊆R times its scalar coefficient; its switching jet is concentrated at D. Its substi- tution is therefore that coefficient times Q i∈D zi. Each scalar ticket coefficient is integrable against the Mark kernel. Finite linearity of integration proves that substitution commutes with the push of this ticket sum. Its value is exactly the push of the priced polynomial inventory. This proves the marked Mark identity from its real counterpart and paid envelopes, with all infinite summations justified by their paid series bounds.
